name: diamond-painting-converter
description: Find diamond painting patterns already purchased and linked to your account. Check the fixed dimensions, confirm the render and download the pattern PDF with a DMC color legend. The plugin does not purchase products, change designs or process payments.

interface.longDescription: Find diamond painting patterns already purchased and linked to your account. Check the fixed dimensions, confirm the render and download the pattern PDF with a DMC color legend. The plugin does not purchase products, change designs or process payments.
defaultPrompt: Welke gekochte patronen staan in mijn account?
Maak de PDF van mijn gekozen patroon.
Toon de DMC-legenda van dit patroon.

publication.release_notes: Initial account-scoped release with explicit confirmation and authenticated downloads.
